verses.html: A Psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
verses.text: A Psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
verses.title: A Psalm of David.

verses.html: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
verses.text: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.

verses.html: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
verses.text: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

verses.html: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
verses.text: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

verses.html: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
verses.text: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.

verses.html: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.
verses.text: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.
